title: Common-stage descent of finite families of finitely presented schemes
statement: For a cofiltered affine-transition inverse system D of qcqs schemes, with limit c, every finite family of finitely presented schemes X_a over c has a simultaneous finite-presentation qcqs model Y_a over one stage. The original X_a occur in cartesian squares. Empty families are allowed. [def-pc-scheme] [pqf-def-affine-morphism] [lem-weil-pbc-limit-affine-transition] [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation]

proof.text: Descend each object by 01ZM(1). Take a common lower bound of the finitely many stages and pull the models back. Pullback pasting gives the required squares, and finite presentation and qcqs are stable under base change. The empty family uses any object of the cofiltered category.

theorem exists_finitePresentation_family_stage
    {I : Type u} [SmallCategory I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u})
    [∀ {i j : I} (a : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map a)]
    [∀ i : I, CompactSpace (D.obj i)]
    [∀ i : I, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)]
    (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c)
    {κ : Type v} [Finite κ] (X : κ → Scheme.{u}) (p : ∀ a, X a ⟶ c.pt)
    [∀ a, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (p a)] [∀ a, QuasiCompact (p a)]
    [∀ a, QuasiSeparated (p a)] :
    ∃ (i : I) (Y : κ → Scheme.{u}) (q : ∀ a, Y a ⟶ D.obj i)
      (h : ∀ a, X a ⟶ Y a),
      (∀ a, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (q a)) ∧
      (∀ a, QuasiCompact (q a)) ∧ (∀ a, QuasiSeparated (q a)) ∧
      ∀ a, IsPullback (h a) (p a) (q a) (c.π.app i)
